cost_order: rotate A/A-best/B/C/D0/D by (doc_index + repetition) modulo 6; repetition 0 is warmup, 1..3 measured
cost_sequence: independent A greedy exactly 32 tokens, ignore EOS only for controlled inputs; never grade these as answers
cost_decode: feed all 32 controlled tokens once, one forward each; first answer prediction belongs to question phase; no argmax or token extraction inside timed controlled decode
cost_input_transfers: prepare prefix/suffix/controlled token tensors on MPS outside phase timers
cost_timers: synchronize before and after setup/prefill/question/controlled decode; guards, selection capture, parsing and file IO outside timers
quality_timers: synchronized setup, full prefix, question, free generation separately; free generation includes argmax/token transfer and per-step resource guard; score/selection capture outside
fresh_request_cost: new empty cache allocation plus full prefill plus question plus controlled decode, with warm process/allocator; no prefix clone or rollback
memory: exact allocated KV/z bytes per method; observed RSS/MPS snapshots after requests are not per-method peaks; shared model and both index banks stay resident
development_local_metrics: G3b fixed-feature coverage/error and G3c actual-state differences remain separate linked diagnostics; neither is final-test answer accuracy
failure_rule: preserve all rows and stop on resource or correctness failure; never tune from final test; no automatic retraining
